payload.description:
Introduce the temporary, versioned compatibility boundary needed while canonical gold migration is in progress.

The loader accepts known legacy shapes only through explicit conversions, stamps the source contract version, emits a warning and migration diagnostic for every converted record, and never lets a legacy field participate directly in scorer identity. It covers both the `pii_signals` layer name and the hard-coded `pii:` mention-key exemption.

This task lands before corpus migration. Removal is a separate task blocked on all gold and fixture migrations plus the readiness gate; combining introduction and deletion in one task made the dependency order impossible.

Definition of done: migration work can load legacy records through one observable compatibility boundary, while canonical contract tests prove the evaluator itself sees only canonical observations.
payload.title: Introduce temporary canonical-migration compatibility loader
